verdict.rationale: Archive handling within a conversion pipeline is a fair question for a document-conversion tool, so the axis applies. However, the evidence never shows Pandoc extracting or repacking ZIP, 7z, or RAR archives as part of a conversion. The only archive-related item is the chunkedhtml output format, which writes a zip of linked HTML files. That is an adjacent output feature, not general archive extract/repack capability.

support.subject: As a power user, archives (ZIP, 7z, RAR) extract and repack as part of a conversion
